senses.gloss: (b. h.; constr. of אַיִן I)nothing, not.
units: Ber. 5ᵃ אין עוף אלא וכ׳ uf (flight, Job V, 7) means nothing else but &c.; a. v. fr.—אֵינִי, אֵינְךָ not I &c. אֵינִי יודע I do not know; do I not know? B. Mets. 97ᵇ; a. fr. Ber. l. c. but the Holy One … אֵינוֹ כן is not so; a. fr.—אֵינוֹ דין is it not a legitimate conclusion?, whence so much the more.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 6:1:12">Y. Naz. VI, 55ᵃ</cite>; a. v. fr.—… <he>אין לי אלא … מניין</he> from this I could only prove …, whence, however, will you deduct …? <cite ref="Chullin 65b:9">Ḥull. 65ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:8:5">Y. Git. IX, end, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>אפי׳ כתב אינו</he> read <he>סימנו</he>.]
